Core Physical AI Memory Principle: Hierarchical Organization Prevents DRAM Bus Saturation
1. Embodied foundation models cannot operate directly on raw volumetric meshes without exhausting edge DRAM bandwidth. 3D Dynamic Scene Graphs compress continuous geometry
into symbolic hierarchies, allowing fast semantic planning at Layer 4/5 while preserving dense TSDF metric contact geometry at Layer 1 for real-time reactive grasping.
